route.instructions: Can you assign this ticket to one of billing, technical support, or delivery? Route it if the main issue identifies one team, including when the customer says which issue to handle first. Ask for clarification if the message is too vague to identify a team or gives equal priority to independent issues for different teams.

criteria.route_to_team: One team can handle the customer's main issue or stated priority.
